synthesis:draft.headline: SA1 5-minute peak 4981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (interval-ending 16:35 UTC)
summary: The 5-minute Regional Reference Price (RRP) peak in SA1 was 4981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (interval ending 16:35 UTC) [ev0436].
The project's analysis threshold was 300.0 $/MWh and 214 five-minute intervals in the window met-or-exceeded that threshold [ev0003][ev0002].

Dispatch TOTALDEMAND in the 5-minute interval of the RRP peak was 1472.82 MW and net interconnector flow reported was -82.59 MW (net flow into SA1 / import) for that 5-minute interval [ev0437][ev0438].

Measured operational demand (30-minute average) in the half-hour containing the event peak (half-hour ending 2026-07-30 17:00 UTC / 2026-07-31 02:30 ACST) was 1466.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand observed was 2173.0 MW (interval ending 2026-07-30 09:30 UTC) [ev0913][ev0898].
Unweighted mean of 5-minute RRP across the window was 416.71 $/MWh [ev0886].

AEMO published a market notice reporting a City West transformer and breaker trip (a non-credible contingency) [c1], and a separate market notice reporting a short-notice outage of the Belalie–Davenport 275 kV line that invoked constraint set S-DVBL_BC-2CP at 16:30 hrs NEM time [c2].
Public POE50 operational-demand forecasts for the half-hours around the peak include 1549.0 MW for 2026-07-30T16:30:00Z and 1510.0 MW for 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z [ev0968][ev0971].

possible_explanations.statement: The high-price episode might be associated with reduced inter-regional transfer capability around 16:30 NEM time, given AEMO's notice of a short-notice outage of the Belalie–Davenport 275 kV line and invocation of constraint set S-DVBL_BC-2CP [c2].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve interconnector capability limits, constraint binding logs, and actual interconnector flow time series for the relevant Vic–SA links spanning 15:30–18:00 UTC to check for reduced import capability or binding constraints coincident with the price peak.

possible_explanations.statement: The 5-minute RRP peak might be associated with a short-duration local supply–demand imbalance (e.g. low available local generation or a fast demand uptick) together with limited imports (net interchange reported at -82.59 MW for the peak interval) [ev0438][ev0437].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain unit-level dispatch (SCADA) changes, unit trips and offer/availability data for generators in SA1 during 06:30–18:30 UTC on 2026-07-30 to identify large offline events or rapid reductions in available capacity.

possible_explanations.statement: Constraint enforcement or FCAS enablement might have influenced dispatch outcomes and prices, given AEMO's constraint-set invocation and the region's trigger thresholds for energy-price change shown in the dispatch procedure [c2][c3].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve FCAS enablement logs, FCAS prices, and constraint binding status for intervals around 16:35 UTC, and check whether any constraint terms were binding or FCAS enablements occurred at the same time as the price peak.
